description: Pattern Intelligence is an AI agent for ecommerce brand management. Ask questions about your business performance, buy box health, price suppression, inventory gaps, and marketplace trends across Amazon, Walmart, and beyond — and get instant, expert-backed answers. Built on Pattern's 13 years of marketplace expertise and 77+T proprietary data points, Pattern Intelligence monitors your brand around the clock, surfaces risks before they hit your P&L, and resolves them automatically. No more waiting on reports or chasing down answers. Pattern Intelligence gives you the intelligence to lead your business, not just report on it — so ecommerce leaders and brand managers can operate at scale with confidence.
